name: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks

description.text: HKSTP drives innovation and technology in Hong Kong, connecting startups, tech companies, talent, investors and partners to accelerate innovation and business growth.

targetApplicants.text: Ailytics’ AI-powered industrial video analytics solution is paving the way for a safer, smarter airport operation. Currently being tested at the new office building site in front of Terminal 1 of the Rome Fiumicino Airport, they are potentially setting new standards in construction site management, empowering teams to act swiftly and ensure worker protection.
